title: Unary language circuit family
statement: Given a language $L$ of Boolean words, define a family of layered circuits, one for each input length $n$. At length $n$, the circuit is the all-ones circuit if the word of $n$ true bits belongs to $L$, and otherwise it is the constant-zero circuit; every layer of every circuit in the family is finite.
hypotheses_covered: Input length $n\in\mathbb N$ in the family definition
